deploy-bot: @channel PROD deploy starting: tag=release/v1.42.0, commit=fa3c9b2. Starting migrations: `db/migrations/2026_03_15_add_orders_idx.sql` and `db/migrations/2026_03_15_backfill_status.sql`. Change window 30m. Runner=deploy-worker-7.

samir: Oncall here — I’ll watch the backfill logs. What’s our fast rollback if the backfill stalls? :eyes:

luisa: Heads-up: the backfill can create long-running UPDATEs. Recommend forcing `statement_timeout=15m` for that job and lowering worker_count to avoid replica lag. I can patch the job now.

anita: Copy. Also pinning web service to commit `fa3c9b2` during migrations to avoid schema drift. No traffic shift until migrations report success.

deploy-bot: MIGRATION JOB STARTED: backfill job id=4829 on db-proxy-3. Logs: https://logs.internal/4829. ETA ~12-15m.

ops-oncall: If replication lag >10s or tail latency spikes >500ms we abort and revert. Playbook: /runbooks/migrations.md — I’m standing by.

luisa: Seeing `pg_stat_activity` spike on replica-2, replication lag at ~6s and rising. Throttling worker_count -> 2 for backfill now.

deploy-bot: 
```
MIGRATION UPDATE: job=4829 status=running
applied_steps=1/2
current_query=UPDATE orders SET status = ...
```

deploy-bot: MIGRATION JOB COMPLETED: backfill job 4829 finished in 9m 42s. status=SUCCESS. Schema migration `2026_03_15_add_orders_idx.sql` applied on primary.

deploy-bot: ALL MIGRATIONS FINISHED: tag=release/v1.42.0 env=prod. Queuing post-deploy checks: smoke tests + canary traffic shift 10% for 10m. Next: `kubectl rollout status deploy/web -n prod` will be monitored.

zach: Smoke tests passing for core order flows. No 500s and create/order latency looks stable. :tada:

samir: Thanks — I’ll keep an eye on the 30m window for tail latency. Rollback plan remains `rollback-to-tag/release/v1.41.9` if we see degradation.

anita: I’ll unpin the web service after smoke + 10m. Nice and steady.
